summary.value: Search component, use to display different variations of a search input

a11y.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, NOT yet human-reviewed

value.rule: Placeholder text should be used cautiously since it disappears once typing starts and can confuse users
value.quote: Placeholder text should be used with caution, as it disappears when users start typing and may cause confusion.

value.rule: Placeholder text must meet accessibility contrast requirements, which can make it hard to distinguish from entered text
value.quote: It must also meet accessibility contrast requirements, which may make it difficult to distinguish from entered text.

value.rule: Screen readers handle placeholder text inconsistently, so information should be given via a label or description instead
value.quote: Screen readers handle placeholder text inconsistently, so information should instead be provided through a label or description.

value.rule: Use a visible label above the search field when the search purpose isn't obvious or when it's part of a form
value.quote: You should use a label above the search field when it is not obvious what users are expected to search for, or when the search field is part of a form.

value.rule: Pressing Esc clears the search field for a consistent cross-browser experience
value.quote: Pressing Esc clears the search field to provide a consistent experience across browsers.

value.rule: Tab navigation moves focus between the input field, clear button and search button
value.quote: Tab navigation allows users to move between the input field, the clear button and the search button.

value.rule: Enter submits the search when the input field has focus
value.quote: Enter submits the search when the input field has focus.

value.rule: Placeholder text must not be the only description, since screen readers handle it differently and it can confuse users
value.quote: Placeholder text should not be used as the only description, as screen readers handle it differently and it can create confusion.

relations.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, NOT yet human-reviewed

composition.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, NOT yet human-reviewed

value.rule: Search should complement navigation, not replace it, and should be avoided when content is easy to navigate without it
value.quote: Avoid search when the content is easy to navigate without search it replaces good navigation — search should complement navigation, not be the only method

value.rule: The width of the search field should reflect the typical length of search terms users enter
value.quote: The width of the search field should reflect the length of the search terms users typically enter.

value.rule: A main site search field should be wider so users can see several words at once
value.quote: A main search field for a website should be wider so users can see several words at once.

value.rule: The field should not be so short that entered text becomes hidden, to avoid forcing scrolling within the field
value.quote: To avoid forcing users to scroll within the field, ensure it is not so short that parts of the text become hidden.

value.rule: Connect a label to Search.Input when a labeled search field is needed
value.quote: If you want a label on the search field, add a label that you connect with Search.Input .
